description:
Kwon Sa-Heon, the older guy next door who’s practically lived under the same roof as me since we were kids. With his good looks and sweet personality, he’s the perfect guy who’s never been without a girlfriend. Cheong-Myeong, who once confessed to him only to be rejected. He’d been avoiding him ever since, but when he starts college, he ends up living with her next-door neighbor, half by choice, half by circumstance... But this time, the vibe feels a little off.

 *"Good job. Now spread your legs.”

“You’re still a kid, so I have to be gentle with you, right?”*

Is he acting this way because he likes me too... or has he just become more affectionate? He keeps pulling me into the world of adults. All these sudden and confusing emotions are buried deep within the heat he radiates.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
